title: Fine-grained carry pressure is lost before register pressure set pruning
summary: Patch 0064 models computed Cc values directly in the MOS pre-RA scheduler and removes avoidable carry saves on the recovered sum/rotate inputs: 409 to 248 bytes and 385 to 285 bytes. The generic TableGen fine-grained pressure-set contract remains uncorrected; its broader repair was rejected after corpus regressions. The scheduler mitigation passes matching-input MIR checks and runtime validation.

Claude Code 2.1.278, model claude-opus-5, high reasoning effort; session 65695418-7e9b-45bd-92e3-2ecfd88ecf0b, agent a35017d73ff4d881d: original sum/rotate inputs and September 25 scheduling measurements.
unknowns: The original September 25 compiler was not recovered. Original C inputs were recovered byte-for-byte; preprocessing and pass captures are from the identified September 26 reconstruction. Default-mode far i32 input fails legalization before scheduling and is not treated as a scheduling regression. Individual corpus size losses are retained in growth-review.json; hot-loop cycles and compiler-time overhead were not measured. An all-XY16 runtime driver fails on baseline and candidate; the cause is unisolated. The original functions pass with a common a16 driver in both function modes. Farblit legalization is tracked separately.

prior_work.source_assessment: The preserved baseline includes runtime indexed increment 2 and 0049-0063. TableGen reads the register-class flag but does not transfer it to initial pressure sets; no local repair was found. Reference 742d554 also omits the assignment. September 26 upstream preparation: exact llvm-mos main 7bd67c0ae4e8 retains the scheduler entry guards and missing TableGen flag propagation. Standalone 0064 changes only MOS scheduling; the original grouped MIR passes this baseline, while a constructed interleaving yields matching-input scheduling red/green and 133 to 59 byte code. See the author review and additional receipt; no generic repair or new causal defect is claimed.
prior_work.binary_assessment: Freshly rebuilt baseline from captured dirty source; independently copied tools and resources with hashes in baseline-identity.json.
prior_work.decision: First canonical record for the historical carry-pressure performance report. Native shift clobber and two-address CSR dependencies are distinct correctness defects.

configuration.checks: fine-grained subset retained with equal-unit alias; ordinary subset pruned

baseline.failure_signature: CHECK: expected string not found in input

mitigation.mechanism: Count live computed virtual Cc values at each scheduling boundary using defining SUnits; prefer candidates reducing excess above one, exclude rematerializable LDImm1 carries, preserve all DAG dependencies.
mitigation.scope: The retained TableGen baseline is still failing. This is a target scheduler mitigation, not closure of that pressure-set contract. Carry values crossing the region through physical registers are outside this additional model.
